## Problem and change
Describe the exercise/data correction, addition, or attribute change.

## Evidence
List affected exercise IDs, supporting sources, and which claims they support.
Identify coach adaptations, imported material, and reuse permission.

## Compatibility
For schema changes: field meanings, units, null handling, migration/version implications.

## Validation
Commands and results, including baseline comparison when applicable.

## Required review tracking
- [ ] Shared database information only; no real client information in files or discussion.
- [ ] Schema, taxonomy, documentation and tests updated where needed.
- [ ] Validation passes.
- [ ] Agent report linked below and covers the latest PR head.
- [ ] Project owner has personally reviewed and explicitly approved the latest changes.
